original_statement: Concurrent approximation/tower publication cannot make an ineligible node eligible; no cache fields, synchronization or serialization format change.
correction: The cache fields, synchronization implementation and serialization format are unchanged. The candidate changes synchronization traffic: it skips the cache pointer load and any read-lock acquisition for ineligible node kinds. Every eligible proof read and every publication retain the original synchronized implementation.
reason_the_skip_is_sound: The sole production publication site uses the same eight-kind predicate as the candidate reader. Node shape is immutable and deserialization starts with an empty cache. Other payloads cannot create a Laurent certificate for an ineligible node. This argument does not assume that locking behavior is unchanged.

crates/hyperreal/src/computable/node/exp: atan_argument, asin_argument, acos_argument: immutable kind/argument matches; any rational argument is reconstructed from the immutable payload

other_cache_payloads: Reads made by actual approximation/tower queries still use their original methods. The new coexistence control uses valid approximate/tower payloads and verifies answers and preservation; existing concurrent publication tests remain in the 879-test qualification.
measurement_limit: No new event instrumentation counts skipped empty-pointer checks versus skipped nonempty-cell read locks; neither the number nor timing share is claimed.
